baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired clauses ما لم ينزل به سلطانا and وما ليس لهم به علم qualify the worship in يعبدون.
baseline_models.mechanism: Cultic submission is tested by two independent warrants: an authority delivered from God and knowledge held by the worshippers. The object is other than God, while neither the external commission nor the internal grasp exists.

activation_trace.role: Submissive obedience supplies the cultic act placed under audit.
Otherness marks the worshipped object as outside the divine referent.
Delivery from above supplies the missing external commission.
A compelling proof supplies the kind of warrant that was never delivered.
Cognitive disclosure supplies the separately denied internal warrant.

changed_reading.before: A conventional condemnation of worshipping other gods.
changed_reading.after: A two-channel warrant audit: this submission has neither a God-sourced commission nor a knower's grasp of its object.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence من دون الله, ينزل, سلطان, الظالمين, and نصير links rank, authorization, injustice, and failed redress.
baseline_models.mechanism: The worshipped object is below the proper goal, has never been placed in an authorized rank, and is nevertheless installed there by worship. ظلم becomes a displacement of rank, while the final denial of a helper closes off vindication of that displacement.

activation_trace.role: Nearness below the goal supplies the object's deficient rank.
Putting something in its proper station supplies the unperformed act of authorization.
Delegated capacity or office supplies the rank the object lacks.
Putting a thing outside its proper place turns false worship into rank-dislocation.
Vindication after injustice supplies the redress specifically unavailable to the dislocators.

changed_reading.before: The wrongdoers are a generic condemned group appended to the worship claim.
changed_reading.after: They are wrongdoers because worship installs a lower object in a station never assigned to it, and that false installation cannot be vindicated.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: يعبدون, من دون, سلطان, and نصير permit a social-power reading of the worship relation.
baseline_models.mechanism: Worship can be self-subjection to a readily taken patron. The patron's imagined coercive reach was never granted by God, so the relation promises protection while producing servitude without rescue.

activation_trace.role: Enslaving or rendering someone servant supplies the social cost of the worship relation.
An invitation to take what is at hand supplies the patron's immediate availability.
Overpowering force supplies the capacity falsely projected onto the patron.
Aid and prevailing support supply the promised function that the patron cannot perform.

changed_reading.before: Worship is only a mistaken belief about a sacred object.
changed_reading.after: Worship is also a counterfeit protection contract: people subject themselves to an available lower patron whose force is uncommissioned and whose aid fails.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The branch range of يعبدون and علم allows repeated service to be read beside the absence of a distinguishing mark.
baseline_models.mechanism: Service may become a levelled, much-travelled route merely through repetition. Yet the route has no disclosed placement and no mark by which its destination can be known; emphatic negation prevents habit from becoming evidence.

activation_trace.role: A levelled travelled road supplies the image of worship hardened into habit.
Proper placement supplies the ordering that habit alone cannot confer.
Categorical negation makes the absence of an identifying warrant explicit.
A visible route-mark supplies the missing indicator that would distinguish and guide the practice.

changed_reading.before: A long-established worship practice might carry its own credibility.
changed_reading.after: Repetition can level a path without marking its destination; inherited ease of practice is not authorization or knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier dispute formula expands the focus ayah's two denials into a credential stack: knowledge, guidance, and an illuminating written record. The later descent of manifest signs supplies the positive counterpart to the authority that was not sent down.

activation_trace.role: Compelling proof remains the focus category being expanded by context.
Twisted contention supplies the speech setting in which missing credentials matter.
Absent cognitive disclosure repeats one limb of the focus audit.
Gentle direction to the true road adds a practical warrant beyond bare information.
A written fixing that entails judgment adds an inspectable normative warrant.
Actual delivery from above supplies the positive contrast to what was never delivered for false worship.
Visible signs supply the disclosed content carried by legitimate descent.
Disclosure through word or sign makes the warrant publicly intelligible.

structural_cues: 22:8 coordinates three negated credentials: knowledge, guidance, and an illuminating book.
22:16 couples actual descent with manifest signs and guidance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a three-part dispute test and a positive sign-bearing descent; I infer that سلطان in 22:71 compresses this warrant ecology, while the live alternative is that authority remains a distinct juridical proof rather than an umbrella for all three.

changed_reading.before: No authority and no knowledge are two vague deficits.
changed_reading.after: The worship claim fails a developed credential test: no knowing, no guidance, no binding record, and no manifest sign-bearing disclosure from God.

context_deltas.mechanism: Worship on an edge is stable only while benefit arrives; assay overturns the worshipper, and the invoked patron proves nearer in harm than benefit. The focus ayah's no-helper ending therefore exposes a transactional patronage contract, not merely an abstract doctrinal error.

activation_trace.role: Denied aid supplies the failed benefit promised by the patronage relation.
Cultic obedience supplies the same act as the focus ayah under a conditional posture.
Deviation from a direction supplies the instability of edge-positioned worship.
Assaying metal or a person supplies the event that tests the contract.
Turning a thing from its face supplies the worshipper's reversal under pressure.
Loss opposed to benefit supplies the patron's actual output.
Benefit opposed to harm supplies the return the worshipper sought.
Protective affiliation supplies the explicit social role occupied by the bad patron.

structural_cues: 22:11 uses matched if-clauses for benefit and trial, followed by bodily reversal and loss.
22:12-13 move from neither harm nor benefit to harm being nearer, then call the relation an evil patronage and companionship.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies conditional worship, reversal under assay, a harm-benefit comparison, and a bad patron; I infer a protection-for-service contract, while the live alternative is an unstable devotional psychology without a social-contract dimension.

changed_reading.before: The worshippers simply chose the wrong supernatural object.
changed_reading.after: They entered a service-for-protection relation whose promised patronage collapses under the very harm-benefit test that motivated it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Protection in the surrounding sequence is permissioned and justice-conditioned: those wronged receive leave, divine aid repels destruction, and empowerment produces ordered public practice. Thus no helper for the wrongdoers means exclusion from authorized protection, not an assertion that they can find no temporary allies.

activation_trace.role: Permission to act supplies the juridical gate before protective force.
Suffered injustice and its claim to redress supply the condition for authorization.
Divine aid supplies the positive counterpart to the focus ayah's denied helper.
Repelling harm supplies protection's concrete function in preserving worshipping communities.
Reciprocal language of aid supplies the allegiance pattern under which help operates.
Granted capacity supplies the institutional result of authorized protection.

structural_cues: 22:39 places permission before fighting and grounds it in being wronged.
22:40 links divine repulsion to the survival of multiple worship sites and repeats aid reciprocally.
22:41 turns empowerment into prayer, almsgiving, recognized good, and restraint of wrong.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies permission, suffered wrong, repulsion, aid, and public consequences; I infer that legitimate سلطان includes justice-bounded protective capacity, while the alternative is that 22:71 speaks only of evidentiary authority and the protection sequence merely supplies moral contrast.

changed_reading.before: No helper is an absolute prediction of social isolation.
changed_reading.after: Wrongdoers are outside the permissioned protection order: force and aid become legitimate only when conditioned by redress and directed toward preserving ordered worship.

context_deltas.mechanism: The absence of knowledge in the focus ayah can be a failure of uptake despite available perception. Travel and eyes may supply data, yet the heart does not bind it into understanding; unknowing is therefore located in the action-producing interior rather than at the retina.

activation_trace.role: Denied disclosure anchors the contextual diagnosis of how knowing fails.
The heart supplies the interior locus assigned understanding and blindness.
Reason that restrains ignorance supplies the missing act of cognitive binding.
Blindness of heart or insight supplies the mechanism of non-knowledge despite exposure.
Physical sight supplies the functioning channel explicitly distinguished from the failure.
The bodily chest supplies the stated container of the blinded hearts.

structural_cues: 22:46 contrasts eyes that are not blind with hearts in chests that are blind.
The verse begins with travel through the land, so failed knowledge follows potential exposure rather than simple sensory deprivation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sensory exposure and an explicit eye-heart contrast; I infer that no knowledge in 22:71 may describe failed integration or refusal, while the live alternative remains literal lack of information about the worshipped object.

changed_reading.before: The worshippers lack facts because no evidence reached them.
changed_reading.after: They may encounter evidence yet fail to turn perception into restraining understanding; the epistemic defect can be internal non-recognition, not mere data scarcity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context depicts transmission as a contested channel in which alien insertion is removed, signs are made firm, and knowledgeable recipients recognize truth. The focus ayah's missing descent is therefore not satisfied by any circulating sacred claim; valid authority belongs to an authenticated, corrected, sign-bearing transmission.

activation_trace.role: Undelivered authorization anchors the question of a valid transmission channel.
Messenger and message supply the authorized carrier relation.
Removal followed by replacement supplies active correction of intrusive material.
Making firm and exact supplies authentication of the retained signs.
Visible signs supply the content secured by the correction process.
Divine knowledge supplies the epistemic control over transmission.
Knowledgeable recipients supply the recognition end of the authenticated channel.
Reality-matching truth supplies what the knowers identify after authentication.

structural_cues: 22:52 sequences sending, intrusive casting, divine removal, and confirmation of signs.
22:53-54 split the result into trial for diseased or hardened hearts and recognition by those given knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a corrected transmission sequence and differentiated reception; I infer an authentication requirement for any claimed descended authority, while the live alternative is that the sequence describes prophetic consolation without defining a general evidentiary protocol.

changed_reading.before: Any inherited sacred message might count as the absent authority if people sincerely transmit it.
changed_reading.after: Transmission alone is insufficient: legitimate warrant is source-selected, resistant to contamination, made firm as signs, and recognizable as reality-matching truth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context turns the focus ayah's below/other relation into a vertical ontology. What is invoked below God lacks truth and stability, while God is explicitly real and high; false worship is therefore an inversion of both rank and reality.

activation_trace.role: Stable correspondence with reality supplies the status explicitly assigned to God.
Position below the goal supplies the vertical relation of the invoked alternatives.
Loss of truth and stability supplies the ontological condition of what is invoked below.
Height and elevation supply the counter-rank explicitly assigned to God.

structural_cues: 22:62 uses matched clauses: God is the real, what they invoke below Him is the false, and God is the high.
The focus ayah repeats the same من دون construction immediately before denying descended authority.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit truth-falsehood and high-below contrasts; I infer that spatial rank images ontological stability, while the live alternative is that دون marks simple otherness and the vertical topology is rhetorical rather than lexical.

changed_reading.before: Besides God only identifies an alternative object.
changed_reading.after: The alternative occupies a doubly false position: below the proper rank and without the reality-stability needed to bear worship.

context_deltas.mechanism: Ritual practice appears as something assigned to communities, disputed before a judge, and set against divine knowledge recorded in a binding book. The focus worship is thus an unassigned ritual claim outside the context's chain of institution, adjudication, and record.

activation_trace.role: A rite's place and performance supply the concrete practice that is assigned.
Pulling between two sides supplies the contest over ritual authority.
Judgment between people supplies the final jurisdiction over the dispute.
Comprehensive divine knowing supplies the basis of adjudication.
A written fixing that entails judgment supplies the authoritative register.
Ease after difficulty supplies the lack of friction in divine registration and recall.

structural_cues: 22:67 says a rite was made for every community and forbids contest over the matter.
22:68-69 move dispute to divine knowledge and judgment.
22:70 places what is known in a book immediately before the focus ayah.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies assigned rites, contest, judgment, knowledge, and inscription; I infer a ritual jurisdiction against which 22:71's worship is unauthorized, while the live alternative is that mansak denotes practice without implying a formal legal registry.

changed_reading.before: False worship is an isolated private choice with no institutional dimension.
changed_reading.after: It is an uncommissioned ritual jurisdiction: a practice claiming communal force without assignment, adjudicable warrant, or entry in the authoritative record.

context_deltas.mechanism: Manifest signs are sequentially recited and visibly recognized in hostile faces, yet recognition flips into denial and threatened seizure. The focus ayah's lack of knowledge can therefore be active non-recognition: evidence registers affectively while being refused propositionally.

activation_trace.role: Denied knowing anchors the question whether the deficit is passive or resistant.
Following in sequence supplies the repeated delivery of recited signs.
Visible signs supply the evidence presented twice in the verse.
Meaning disclosed by speech or sign supplies the signs' intelligibility.
Recognition by a trace or mark supplies the narrator's reading of the faces.
The outward face supplies the surface on which inward response becomes legible.
The opposite of recognition supplies the resistant response despite visible registration.

structural_cues: 22:72 repeats signs at both recitation positions and locates a recognizable response in faces.
The threatened physical reaction follows, rather than precedes, the presentation of manifest signs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies clear recitation, facial recognizability, denial, and threatened action; I infer that some non-knowledge is motivated refusal after affective registration, while the live alternative is that the face merely displays anger without any conceded cognition.

changed_reading.before: They worship without knowledge because the relevant signs are absent.
changed_reading.after: Their faces can register manifest signs while their stance converts recognition into denial; no knowledge may name resisted uptake, not unavailable evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The parable submits the invoked powers to a minimal capability test: collective effort cannot create a fly, and they cannot extract even a seized item from it. The weak seeker-sought circuit is then contrasted with God's measured capacity, gathered strength, and prevailing might. سلطان and نصير become operational rather than titular.

activation_trace.role: Overpowering capacity supplies the authority claim tested by the parable.
Aid supplies the promised function falsified by failed recovery.
Making a likeness visible supplies the explicit experimental frame.
The fly supplies the deliberately minimal adversary and object of creation.
Gathering the dispersed supplies the maximum collective effort that still fails.
Extracting something from another's grip supplies the concrete rescue task they cannot perform.
The opposite of strength supplies the verdict on both sides of the dependency relation.
Seeking and being sought supply the closed circuit of mutual incapacity.
Capacity reaching effective action supplies what the worshippers fail to assess in God.
Strength gathered like strands of a rope supplies the divine contrast to weakness.
Prevailing force supplies the effective might absent from the invoked objects.

structural_cues: 22:73 moves from failed creation even after collective assembly to failed retrieval of a snatched item.
The branchless س ل ب occurrence at 22:73 word 20 concretizes loss but is retained only as a structural cue, with no invented branch ID.
22:74 immediately contrasts failed appraisal with divine strength and might.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed creation, collective failure, failed extraction, paired weakness, and divine strength; I infer that a true helper or authority must pass a minimal recovery test, while the live alternative is that the parable tests creation alone and rescue is a secondary humiliation.

changed_reading.before: The other gods lack an abstract legal title and will not help at judgment.
changed_reading.after: Their authority fails an observable stress test now: they cannot originate minimal life, retain possessions, or recover loss, so the entire seeker-patron circuit is functionally weak.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after the failed powers, God selects messengers from angels and humans, hears and sees, knows what lies before and behind them, and receives the return of affairs. Legitimate descent therefore has selected carriers and an all-knowing source; the worshipped alternatives appear nowhere in that commission chain.

activation_trace.role: Delivery from God anchors the missing commission whose positive chain follows.
Choosing the select supplies source-controlled appointment of carriers.
Messenger and message supply the commissioned carrier role.
Hearing supplies the source's complete reception of voiced claims.
Seeing supplies the source's complete inspection of visible acts.
Knowing what surrounds the carriers supplies comprehensive oversight of the chain.
Return to the prior source supplies final accountability of every affair.

structural_cues: 22:75 places divine selection before the category of messengers from angels and humans.
22:76 surrounds those carriers with divine knowledge and returns all affairs to God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies selection, messengers, perception, knowledge, and return; I infer a closed commission chain from source through carrier back to source, while the live alternative is that messenger selection illustrates divine power without defining every form of سلطان.

changed_reading.before: Sent-down authority could be any claim attributed to heaven.
changed_reading.after: A valid heavenly claim has a selected carrier, an all-perceiving and all-knowing source, and final return to that source; the alternative cult has no node in this chain.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ending supplies the positive social body missing from false worship: embodied worship and good action, selected membership, reciprocal witness, protective holding, patronage, and aid. No helper for wrongdoers becomes exclusion from this attached and accountable helper relation rather than a free-standing threat.

activation_trace.role: Obedient worship supplies the authorized counterpart to the focus ayah's misdirected service.
Winning and enduring supply the outcome attached to embodied worship and good action.
Selection and drawing near supply the community's commissioned membership.
Testimony grounded in knowledge supplies reciprocal public accountability.
A hold that prevents and protects supplies the attachment preceding patronage and aid.
Protective affiliation supplies God's positive patron role.
Aid and prevailing support supply the explicit reversal of no helper in 22:71.

structural_cues: 22:77 coordinates bowing, prostration, worship, and doing good before success.
22:78 sequences selection, inherited communal naming, reciprocal witness, prayer, almsgiving, holding fast, patronage, and help.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an embodied practice sequence and ends with holdfast, patron, and helper; I infer that attachment and accountable practice form the positive protection circuit denied to wrongdoers, while the live alternative is that the final helper title is a general doxology rather than the designed reversal of 22:71.

changed_reading.before: The final no-helper clause only adds punishment to the condemnation.
changed_reading.after: It marks a relational exclusion: false service cannot enter the selected, witnessed, embodied, and protective attachment in which God is patron and helper.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation is surprising because it uses the oil-that-lights branch of سلطان rather than its primary proof or power branches. It remains anchored in the focus word and is activated by the explicit illuminating book of 22:8 plus علم as a distinguishing mark. Downstream prose should present it only as a secondary illumination image, not as a lexical replacement for proof.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: سلطانا stands beside denied علم, while 22:8 pairs the same denied علم with كتاب منير.

activation_trace.role: Oil used for lighting supplies an exploratory image of authority as an illuminant.
A distinguishing mark supplies what illumination would make legible.
Ordered writing supplies the surface on which warrant can be inspected.
Light and illumination supply the explicit contextual activator for the distant سلطان branch.

changed_reading.before: Authority is only a forceful argument possessed or absent.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, valid authority also behaves like lamp-oil for an illuminating record: it makes the marks of a claim readable, whereas false worship remains epistemically unlit.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-verse spatial braid, not a claim that 22:71 literally mentions a rope. It remains valid because the focus couples descent and help, while 22:15 couples divine help with a rope-link toward the sky and its severing. Downstream prose should label it imagistic and keep uncertainty about the directional relation explicit.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus denies both God-sourced descent and a helper, creating a vertical-support pair.

activation_trace.role: Delivery from above supplies one end of the focus ayah's vertical relation.
Aid supplies the support function denied at the other end.
Expected divine aid supplies the context's explicit support question.
A rope or connecting link supplies the material image of support toward the sky.
The sky as what is above and covers supplies the upper terminus of the link.
Severing a connection supplies the imagined destruction of the support line.

changed_reading.before: No helper is a flat absence of an ally.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the false cult is disconnected vertical infrastructure: no warrant descends, no sustaining link holds, and attempted severance cannot resolve the resulting rage.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is spatially surprising because it places the focus ayah between a shirk-as-fall image and a sky-held-until-permission image. It remains anchored in دون, ينزل, and the explicit lack of authority, but it should not be rendered as though نزّل itself means uncontrolled falling. Downstream prose should preserve it as a contextual contrast between authorized descent and uncontained collapse.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: من دون الله and لم ينزل به سلطانا make vertical rank and unauthorized descent available within the focus ayah.

activation_trace.role: Position below the goal supplies the lower destination of the spatial model.
Placement in a proper station supplies the controlled descent absent from the false claim.
Noisy unstable falling supplies the bodily trajectory assigned to association.
Rapid snatching supplies loss of control during the fall.
Falling into an abyss supplies the alternative terminal trajectory.
Wind in motion supplies the force carrying the unsupported worshipper away.
Holding and restraining supplies divine containment of the sky.
Falling and coming to rest supplies the event being prevented.
Permission supplies the sole gate through which cosmic falling may occur.

changed_reading.before: God has issued no decree supporting the worshipped objects.
changed_reading.after: The surrounding spatial field distinguishes permission-governed descent from shirk's uncontrolled fall: the lower cult has neither an assigned landing nor the authority that contains collapse.

strongest_changes: The two focus denials expand into a full warrant ecology of knowledge, guidance, binding record, manifest signs, authenticated transmission, and selected carriers.
No helper becomes a failed patronage and rescue system, most concretely exposed when the invoked powers cannot recover even what a fly takes.
Wrongdoing becomes rank-dislocation and exclusion from justice-conditioned, permissioned protection rather than generic badness.
Lack of knowledge can be heart-level or actively resistant non-recognition despite sensory and affective registration of signs.
The closing helper reversal in 22:78 supplies a coexisting positive model of embodied worship, witness, attachment, patronage, and aid.
summary.what_was_special: The packet made the verse unusually mechanical: vertical rank, evidentiary authorization, transmission control, patronage, and material rescue all converge without collapsing into one reading. The strongest surprise was that سلطان and نصير can be stress-tested by the fly parable, while the illumination, severed-link, and uncontrolled-fall readings remain live only under explicit containment.
remaining_uncertainties: سلطان may remain primarily compelling proof, primarily delegated power, or intentionally hold both; the context supports coexistence but does not force a single sense.
The rank-dislocation and descent/fall models may be contextual spatial metaphors rather than direct lexical meanings of the focus constructions.
No knowledge may describe genuine absence, failed integration, or motivated refusal; 22:46 and 22:72 keep all three possibilities active.
The illuminating-oil and support-line activations are branch-distant and should never displace the stronger warrant and rescue models.
